rights_policy.git_policy: Tracked files retain exact queries, bibliographic titles/identifiers required for the reproducible diagnostic audit, codes, counts, hashes, and safe controller receipts. Licensed abstracts, result URLs, browser/session data, stdout record previews, and full source artifacts remain in the ignored restricted directory.
